target_customer: Post-acute and long-term care operators and skilled nursing facilities
problem: Skilled nursing facilities lost revenue and time on billing, Medicaid and admissions workflows that sat across EHRs and payer systems.
product_category: Healthcare revenue integrity and workflow software

founders.name: Dennis Antonelos
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no employers or education.

founders.name: Mehrdad Shafaie
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no employers or education.

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating EHR data with Medicare, Medicaid and payer data and automating billing rules is standard integration work with hard healthcare data parts.

defensibility.rationale: Deep EHR and billing integration in facilities is sticky, but incumbents like EHR vendors could add features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: PointClickCare launched revenue cycle services for skilled nursing in May 2021; CoreCare kept growing and later sold its Pre-Admit product to ExaCare AI.

market_need_then: Skilled nursing providers bill Medicaid and Medicare through slow and error-prone processes; the 2020 seed coverage described an ML system connecting EHR data with payer data.

branding.domain_note: Operates corecare.ai; the .com host returned HTTP 503 when fetched.

identity.voice_and_tone: Enterprise healthcare ops language such as Collaborative Revenue Management.

brand_strength.rationale: Only press releases found; the name is generic and shares form with many health companies.

outcome_analysis: CoreCare raised a $3M seed in October 2020 and has since disclosed no further rounds, yet it reports over 1,000 locations using the platform. In April 2026 it moved its Pre-Admit product to ExaCare AI to focus on its revenue integrity platform. It is active, and funding beyond the seed is unknown.
notes: corecare.com returned HTTP 503, so the company site was not read; YC page was. Seed also reported by TechCrunch on 2020-10-29 per a search result; the TechCrunch page was not opened. Aggregators list total funding at $3.13M to $3.15M. The Pre-Admit sale is an asset sale reported by the acquirer release; its date comes from a search summary and the headline exit is none. Competitor list left empty: the only rival evidence found (PointClickCare RCM launch) is dated May 2021, nine months after the batch.
